notes.title: PATCH 1.3

PATCH 1.3

- The weight of the game has been reduced.
- Some bugs in the menus have been fixed.
- The movies have been reduced in weight for more fluidity.
-  To notice the changes you will have to reinstall the game.

notes.title: PATCH 0.2
notes.notes:
Patch 0.2

- The saving system has been fixed, now the whole level is restarted and not only some parts.
- Fixed a bug where the player was still moving after opening a keypad.
- Some decoration objects have been touched up.
- Some bugs related to puzzles have been fixed.
- Adjustments.
